senses.gloss: m. (κοχλίας, cochlea) any thing spiral, a spiral stair-case, screw &c. (v. Gr. a. Lat. Dict. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:16">Tosef. Succ. IV, 16</cite> <he>מקיפין ועומדין כקבולין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>בכולייס</he>, <he>ככולייר</he>, read <he>בכוכלייס</he>) stood around in a spiral figure; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:10">Tosef. Yoma I, 10</cite> <he>בקבילין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>בכלאים</he>, <he>ככוליור</he>); <cite ref="Yoma 25a:4">Yoma 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כמין בכוליאר</he> (Ms. M. <he>כולייר</he>, O. a. L. <he>ככולייר</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 7:1:2">Y. Shek. VII, beg. 50ᶜ</cite> <he>כמין כובלין היו עשויין</he> (corr. acc.) the boxes in the Temple for contributions were put up so as to form a spiral figure; (Bab. ed. <cite ref="S00232"><he>קובליים</he></cite>, <he>בוכלייאר</he>, <he>כובליי׳</he>, corr. acc.).
